_comment: First cream config, 2026-08-19. Carries every fix the Glutathione run exposed. product_desc: Skingenetix PDRN Collagen Repair Deep Renewal Treatment: a 50ml frosted SOFT PINK glass cosmetic jar, wide and squat - noticeably WIDER THAN IT IS TALL, about 1.15 times wider than its full height - with a deep brushed satin ALUMINIUM screw lid. The lid is a tall band standing about a THIRD of the jar's total height and roughly HALF the height of the glass body beneath it; it is not a thin disc or a shallow cap. The lid has a fine vertical brushed grain and is satin, never a chrome mirror. The glass is frosted pale rose-pink, deeper at the shoulders and lighter towards the base - keep it PINK and do not render it white, amber, gold or peach. Reproduce the front label exactly as in the reference, every character verbatim and in these colours: the Skingenetix DNA-helix mark and the 'Skingenetix' wordmark in BLACK, spelled with a CAPITAL 'S' and the rest lower case, with no registered-trademark, copyright or any other symbol anywhere near it; a narrow vertical ROSE rule down the left of the text block; 'PDRN COLLAGEN REPAIR' in BLACK bold capitals on ONE line; 'DEEP RENEWAL TREATMENT' in ROSE capitals; 'PREMIUM FORMULA' in BLACK light capitals; and 'PDRN  |  COLLAGEN  |  COPPER PEPTIDE  |  50ML' in small BLACK capitals at the base. The volume is 50ML. THE JAR LABEL CARRIES ONLY THE LINES LISTED ABOVE. It does NOT carry the benefit triplet 'PLUMPING | FIRMING | REPAIRING', nor 'ALL SKIN TYPES', nor any ingredient list - those belong to the carton only, and printing them on the jar is wrong. BRAND ACCENT COLOUR: this product's brand colour is ROSE - a soft dusty antique pink. Wherever a shot calls for a brand colour, brand gradient or accent glow, build it from that rose and warm neutrals. Never gold, purple, blue, green or orange.
_packaging_desc_help: Written face by face because a model renders a box in one colour unless told otherwise. The cream carton is a WIDE SHORT box, unlike the tall slim serum carton. Source: the dieline, which also specifies the two stock finishes by name.
packaging_desc: The product carton is a WIDE, SHORT rectangular box - broader than it is tall, sized to hold a squat 50ml jar, quite unlike a tall slim serum carton. It has TWO large faces in DIFFERENT colours meeting at crisp edges, each colour holding right up to the edge. The PINK FACE is matte metallic soft dusty pink and carries, from top to bottom: the Skingenetix DNA-helix mark and 'Skingenetix' wordmark in WHITE; a narrow vertical WHITE rule down the left of the text block; 'PDRN COLLAGEN REPAIR' in BLACK bold capitals on one line; 'DEEP RENEWAL TREATMENT' in WHITE bold capitals; 'PLUMPING  |  FIRMING  |  REPAIRING' in smaller BLACK capitals; then a line reading 'PREMIUM FORMULA  |  ALL SKIN TYPES' where 'PREMIUM FORMULA' is BLACK and 'ALL SKIN TYPES' is WHITE; and finally 'PDRN  |  COLLAGEN  |  COPPER PEPTIDE  |  50ML' in small BLACK capitals. The SILVER FACE is matte metallic silver - a brushed pale silver, NOT white cardboard and NOT a mirror - and carries the identical layout and identical wording, but with the DNA-helix mark, the wordmark, the vertical rule, 'DEEP RENEWAL TREATMENT' and 'ALL SKIN TYPES' in ROSE instead of white, while 'PDRN COLLAGEN REPAIR', the benefit triplet, 'PREMIUM FORMULA' and the small ingredient line stay BLACK. The narrow side panels are printed in the same pink and silver and carry small paragraphs of ingredient and directions text, too small to read at this distance - render them as fine unreadable print, and never as the literal words 'body copy' or any other placeholder. FINISH: the dieline specifies 'Mat Metalic Soft Pink' and 'Mat Metalic Silver' with a luxury satin finish. Render a soft brushed sheen with a broad diffuse falloff across each face, never a mirror, never reflective foil, never chrome. PRINT NOTHING THAT IS NOT LISTED ABOVE. Every word on this carton is specified in this description; do not invent, translate, paraphrase or add any further wording, claims or ingredient names on any face.
